errors.name: NegativeStockError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to set a wine's stock quantity to a negative value.

errors.name: InvalidPricingException
errors.description: Raised when a wine's selling price is not strictly greater than its cost price.

errors.name: LocationOverCapacityException
errors.description: Raised when attempting to assign a wine bottle to a storage location that would exceed its defined maximum bottle capacity.

errors.name: DuplicateWineNameError
errors.description: Raised when trying to add a wine with a name that already exists in the system.

errors.name: StorageLocationNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested storage location is not found in the system during lookup or assignment.

errors.name: WineNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested wine by ID is not found in the system during lookup or retrieval.
